verdict.rationale: Paperspace's official docs live on docs.digitalocean.com, which serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200). Paperspace pages are also available as agent-friendly markdown (/products/paperspace/.md and index.html.md variants), alongside a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. However, the llms.txt is DigitalOcean-wide, and nothing in the evidence shows it indexes or curates Paperspace content specifically. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers Paperspace docs, Paperspace-specific agent-oriented guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.digitalocean.com/llms.txt # DigitalOcean Documentation
The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json
